verdict.rationale: dlt explicitly markets 'lineage-aware pipeline runs' via dltHub orchestration, and pipeline metadata (schema versions, load_info, dataset access) provides source-to-table traceability plus monitoring/logs for runs, giving partial lineage visibility. However there is no evidence of a dedicated lineage graph/visualization, column-level lineage, or a UI showing which sources/steps/transformations produced each table end-to-end. Missing for 10: column-level/table-level lineage graph UI, cross-tool lineage integration (e.g. OpenLineage), and independent confirmation of lineage accuracy.
